meta.title: Optimize homepage post loading by eliminating N+1 queries for user data
meta.body_summary: Eliminate N+1 queries in homepage post loading by implementing batch user fetching with a single IN query and cache-aware post conversion.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed N+1 queries with batch user fetch; PR closed without human review due to missing CLA, release note, and code duplication quality gate.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 206 changed lines, this is a small backend edit primarily in PostPublicQueryServiceImpl. The PR was closed, not merged, contrasting with typical small-step performance PRs that merge quickly; closure likely due to process barriers rather than technical rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: CLA not signed, missing release-note label, SonarQube quality gate failed with 9.8% duplication; no human reviewer engaged.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate N+1 queries by batch fetching users, reducing queries from O(N) to O(1).
review_details.rejection_signals: Bot labels (do-not-merge) and SonarQube duplication failure; PR closed without human review comment.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented functional optimization but failed to satisfy repository CLA, release not labeling, and code quality gates; reveals dependency on process steps requiring human intervention.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or reproducible performance test; only narrative claim and a 93% reduction estimate.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Added UserService.getUsersOrGhostByNames for batch user fetch, modified PostPublicQueryServiceImpl to collect usernames, fetch all users in one query, and process posts using a user cache; added overloaded convertToListedVo accepting user map.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most added lines implement batch loading logic; test file only incremented lines.
change_trajectory: Implementation: batch user fetching, cache-aware post conversion.

review_signals.summary: Added do-not-merge/work-in-progress and do-not-merge/release-note-label-needed labels due to missing release note block.
SonarQube quality gate failed: 9.8% duplication on new code exceeds 3% threshold.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with batch user fetching optimization.
Bots flagged missing CLA, release-note label, and SonarQube duplication failure.
No human review received; PR closed without merge.
